items.title: Russia targets Kyiv crossings days after Ukraine hits Crimean Bridge
items.description: Russia launched one of its biggest air attacks yet as it rejected the prospect of security guarantees for Ukraine.

items.title: Russian missile hits Poland as Ukraine's allies hold military exercise, says Tusk
items.description: Nobody was hurt and no damage has been reported, but Warsaw described the incident as a "provocation" from Moscow.

items.title: Nearly 600 women killed in South Africa within three months
items.description: Police officials called for "greater efforts to prevent... violence" against women and children.

items.title: White House removes cyber-security chief after series of tech outages
items.description: CBS is reporting he has been fired after losing the confidence of White House chief of staff Stephen Miller.

items.title: South Korea catches 111 students with new measures against exam cheating
items.description: The students were caught with banned smart devices while taking the high-stakes Suneung exam.

items.title: Nigeria moves to end jail terms for attempted suicide
items.description: Nigeria's proposed reform follows years of calls from psychiatrists and a parallel Senate bill.

items.title: 'I tell my son it's just fireworks': Life inside Yemeni city besieged by Houthis
items.description: Orla Guerin speaks to seven people trapped in the key city of Taiz, cut off from the outside world for weeks.

items.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
items.description: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

items.title: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
items.description: Anthropic is the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, creating a test for the entire industry.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi release 'peace declaration' after historic meeting
items.description: While the presidents have previously met for one-on-one meetings, this is their first trilateral discussion.

items.title: Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya minority, top UN court rules
items.description: The unprecedented International Court of Justice verdict concerns a 2017 military crackdown that killed thousands.

items.title: US army warns detonation of unstable explosives will create toxic plume
items.description: The Army has delayed the controlled explosion of unstable lead azide in eastern Iowa to Monday after concerns from residents and lawmakers.
